LolSikins
=========

A custom skin manager for League of Legends. Only you see the skins; the other players in the match see the
normal skins.

Setup
-----
1. Install LTK Manager first (https://github.com/LeagueToolkit/ltk-manager/releases). LolSikins uses its patcher
   to apply skins and does not include one of its own.
2. Extract the whole zip into a folder (for example C:\Games\LolSikins). Do not use a folder synced by OneDrive.
3. Run LolSikins.exe. If Windows says "Unknown publisher" or "Windows protected your PC", choose
   "More info" -> "Run anyway".
4. In the settings pick your League of Legends folder (Riot Games\League of Legends, the one that contains "Game").
5. The cart icon in the top bar opens the skin store. It reads the default skin repository; you can enter another
   one as "user/repo" and press CONNECT. Press INSTALL on the skins you want.
6. Turn a skin on in the list, press START, then join a match.

Good to know
------------
- Riot's terms of service do not allow third-party programs that change game files. Using this is a risk to your
  account and it is your own.
- Use fan-made skins only. Do not use copies of Riot's paid skins or mods that give an advantage in game.
- If you enter a GitHub token for a private skin repository, it is saved in plain text in config.ini. Do not share
  this folder; share a fresh zip instead.
- If the program says the patcher was not found, install or reinstall LTK Manager.
- The patcher has an end-of-life date. When the program says it is reached, update LTK Manager to its latest version.
- If something goes wrong, send log.txt from this folder to the person who gave you LolSikins.
